name: risk-budgeted-allocator
author: MEFAI
summary: Turn a (symbol, timeframe, equity, current drawdown) decision into a position notional, leverage and margin using drawdown-budget fractional-Kelly sizing, so a trade can never breach the max-drawdown disqualification rule.

inputs.name: stop_distance
inputs.description: Stop fraction; omit to use the empirical adverse-excursion stop.

inputs.name: regime_gate
inputs.description: 0..1 scale from a regime skill; 0 stands aside.

inputs.name: conviction
inputs.description: 0..1 conviction from a fusion or selection skill.

inputs.name: venue_max_leverage
inputs.description: Hard leverage ceiling for the venue.

inputs.name: horizon
inputs.description: 1h, 4h or 24h horizon for the expectancy lookup.

outputs.name: approved
outputs.description: Whether any size is allowed given the remaining budget.

outputs.name: worst_case_loss
outputs.description: Loss at the stop, guaranteed within the remaining drawdown budget.

primary.description: Realized expectancy and adverse-excursion stops from 195k labeled MEFAI signal outcomes (pinned synthetic sample for reproducible backtests).

backtest.pass_criteria: Worst-case loss stays within the budget for every scenario, position size is monotone non-increasing in current drawdown, and size is zero at or past the cap.
